gaps.sentence: ___ comparison with last year, sales have doubled.
The new policy was introduced ___ response to rising demand.
gaps.explanation: 'in response to' = as a reaction to.

gaps.sentence: I'm in no ___ — take your time deciding.
___ all appearances, the house had stood empty for years.
gaps.explanation: 'To all appearances' = as far as one can tell from looking.

gaps.sentence: The library stays open ___ to midnight during the exam period.
gaps.explanation: 'Up to midnight' = until as late as midnight.

gaps.sentence: He acted on his own ___ and did not ask permission.
gaps.hint: on your own ___ = without being told
gaps.explanation: 'On one's own initiative' = deciding and acting independently.

gaps.sentence: He completed the marathon despite being ___ breath.
gaps.explanation: 'out of breath' = breathing fast from effort.

gaps.sentence: We finished the report ___ time for the meeting.
gaps.explanation: 'in time for' = early enough; 'on time' = punctual.
